findings.action:
Recognize valid reference definitions or report them as unknown. The expression excludes multiline labels and escaped closing brackets, and its line anchor excludes definitions inside blockquotes. Read-only probes using the extracted production expressions returned no destinations for '[decision][decision label]

[decision
label]: ../adr/decision.md', '[decision][d]

> [d]: ../adr/decision.md', and an escaped-bracket label; CommonMark rendering resolves each to decision.md. Equivalent backlinks to pair.md also disappear. Because no match reaches add(), no diagnostic is produced. With two canonical members and no other association, the evaluator returns Known=true and Required=false, violating R3. Cover both directions and ensure unsupported local association syntax cannot prove absence.

Handle escaped angle brackets inside angle-bracket destinations without silently dropping the link. For '[decision](<../adr/decision.md#f\> with space>)', CommonMark resolves the destination to decision.md with a fragment, but the extracted production expressions return no destinations. The angle branch stops at the escaped '>', while the bare branch cannot consume the spaces. '[program](<../roadmaps/pair.md#f\> with space>)' fails identically in the reverse direction. No undecodable diagnostic is generated, so a two-member roadmap with only this association receives a known exemption. Parse the complete destination or fail closed and add forward/backward regression cases.

Preserve backslash-escaped ampersands while decoding character references. CommonMark resolves '[decision](../adr/decision\#name.md)' to '../adr/decision#name.md', a permitted ADR basename. The implementation first applies html.UnescapeString, turning '#' into '#', then removes the backslash and strips the supposed fragment. A read-only decoding probe confirmed that the production path becomes '../adr/decision'; the extension predicate silently skips it. With that regular ADR present and no other association, the result is a known exemption rather than required review. Decode Markdown escapes and entities with their actual precedence, and cover escaped entity introducers. This is an unresolved part of R14-N48.
Complete spec follow-up F6 with context-aware Markdown parsing while preserving fail-closed handling of unsupported local associations.
findings.rationale: The existing F6 residual risk remains: links in code/comments count as associations, and destinations containing parentheses can become unknown. This conservatively requires extra review and does not itself grant an exemption. Inspection and the independently passing RoundTwelve/RoundFourteen regressions support retaining this limited over-enforcement risk.
